title: feat(lint)!: refuse an action's copy-template findings (blank, unbound root, single-brace, logic, raw-shown ${…}) at validate, compile and the publish gate
body:
Fixes #25680

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Ruling-ref: `6365736632` (on #24814, the refusal half: "its own BREAKING minor card, filed when this card lands, as #25205 is for the bulk slot"); triage `6386348015`

The refusal half of ruling `6365736632` on #24814, verbatim: "**The refusal half** (blank and door findings as errors) is its own BREAKING minor card, filed when this card lands, as #25205 is for the bulk slot." #24814 (PR #25637, `384bb7ba02`) typed an action's copy keys as ADR-0032 `template` slots and shipped every door finding as a warning. This PR makes them errors, shaped like #25205 / PR #25451 for the bulk slot.

## What changes

- **The action copy pass refuses** (`packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`, `judgeAction`). A blank sentence, a hole over a root the key does not bind, a single-brace `{x}` token, a hole holding logic or an unknown formatter, and a `${…}` token the runner shows raw are now `severity: 'error'`, and the `ADVISORY` suffix is gone from them. The judge, the walk, the roots and the sentences are unchanged.
- **How it reaches each door.** `objectstack validate` and `compile` fail on an `error` from `validateStackExpressions`. The publish gate splits `errors` from `advisories` by severity (`runtime-gate.ts`), so an active `action`, `object` or `page` write, and a draft promotion, answer `422 INVALID_METADATA` with an `expression-invalid` issue at the key. No door code moves.
- **`${…}`: kept a warning only where objectui's runner still fills it.** Measured at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `2958f17e9c` (objectui `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`): `confirmMessage` still evaluates a `confirmText` with no `{{ }}` hole through its `${…}` expression evaluator (whose `record` is the record the action runs against), and `composeSuccessMessage` still substitutes `${result.*}` (and nothing else) in a `successMessage` with no `{{ }}` hole; an `errorMessage` is shown as written (`actionCopySource`, no substitution). So, per the triage's lead, a `${…}` token stays a **warning** exactly when the runner fills it: a sentence with no `{{ }}` hole whose every token is `${record.*}` (`confirmText`) or `${result.*}` (`successMessage`). Its finding now ends "A warning, not a refusal, for now: the console's runner still fills …". Every other `${…}` is shown raw by the runner, so it is an error: in an `errorMessage`, beside a `{{ }}` hole or a `{x}` token, over `params` in a `confirmText`, or over `record` in a `successMessage`.
  - The roots are a spec fact beside the slot's other runner-measured roots: `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`). The shape is read by the one template reader: `dollarOnlyTokenRoots` (`@objectstack/spec/automation`, beside `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`), so lint holds no second reading of the dialect.
- **The blank arm is kept** (`actionCopyTemplateSlot`, comment only), following #25205's answer for the bulk slot. The parse is what the boot load and the read path judge a stored row with; dropping the arm would make a stored blank sentence an invalid row on load, a narrowing wider than the three doors. The doors refuse a blank sentence in this same change, so every finding is one kind of verdict: a door refusal over text that parses. Door test (d) pins this for a blank and for an unbound hole.
- **Prose made false by the flip, corrected:** the module notes (`action-copy-template.ts` "Widening only" section, `validate-action-copy-templates.ts`), the three copy `.describe()`s and their regenerated references (`content/docs/references/{ui/action,ui/component,data/object,kernel/metadata-plugin}.mdx`), the `authoring-rules.ts` registration comment, three `validate-expressions.ts` comments, and the dogfood `expression-conformance.ledger.ts` rows' `enforcement` / `note` text. `affected-docs.mjs --json origin/main` named 17 pages (4 release-owned, untouched); none of the 13 hand-written ones states the warning-only rule or a `${…}` copy sentence, so none changes.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25680-action-copy-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, both declaration lines, a FROM/TO block, and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, worded like #25205's.

## Producers, measured first (through the built `@objectstack/lint` at `6021b5e837`, before the change)

- `examples/app-crm`, `app-showcase` (23 registered `successMessage`s, 29 pages), `app-todo` (2 `confirmText`, 16 `successMessage`), `app-multi-package`: 0 findings. `@objectstack/platform-objects` (12 `confirmText`, 48 `successMessage`, as one stack of its exported objects): 0. `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` (9 `successMessage`): 0. Control: a planted `{{ nope.x }}` drew 1 (a warning before, an error after).
- HotCRM `a4b3560` (read-only clone): its 20 action sentences (1 `confirmText`, 19 `successMessage`, `src/{sales,service,marketing}/actions`) judged through the same built pass: 0 findings, against an error for a planted `{count}`. Its bulk `confirmText`s are #25205's pass, already measured there.
- No producer is refused, so none is converted.

## Tests (head `c69a7a6d`; final head `f03deb5f` adds only the changeset's `Ruling-ref:` line, and the ten changeset / doc families re-ran on it, all exit 0)

- `validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts`: every pin flips from `warning` to `error`, plus new cases: a single-brace token and an empty blank as errors; the four raw-shown `${…}` shapes as errors; `${…}` in a row's `errorMessage` as an error; the transitional `${record.*}` / `${result.*}` as warnings; and the gate block now asserts `errors` with empty `advisories` for a page write (single-brace, unbound, blank), errors for an action and an object write, and one advisory for each transitional sentence. 17/17.
- `flow-text-slot-template.test.ts`: `dollarOnlyTokenRoots` answers the roots for an all-`${…}` holeless sentence and `undefined` for no token, a `{{ }}` hole, a bare `{x}`, logic, and an empty string. `action-copy-template.test.ts`: the transition roots per key.
- New door block in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, through the real `saveMetaItem`: (a) each of four texts on a page row is refused with `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 and nothing is stored, an action write is refused the same way, and the draft promotion is refused too; (b) the door's finding equals `runAuthoringRules('build', …)`'s on `rule`, `where` and `message`; (c) control: the transitional `${record.name}` sentence saves with one advisory; (d) a stored page with a blank or an unbound sentence loads (`invalid: 0`) and its next save is refused, the row untouched. 10/10.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the refuse helper's `severity: 'error'` back to `'warning'`; blob `dcede89c7bb5` → `60fcaccce37a`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` dist reading PASSED on the mutated build): lint `Tests 9 failed | 8 passed`, door `Tests 9 failed | 1 passed` (the passing one is control (c)). Restore leg: blob back to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, lint rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, lint 17/17 and door 10/10 green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 161/161 files, 7273 tests; typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 719/719 files, 21779 passed, 1 todo; typecheck exit 0; `test:repo` 79/79 files, 1269 tests. `check:generated` green after `--fix` regenerated api-surface, export-origins and the references, and green again after merging `origin/main`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` (the door's consumer): 263 passed / 3 skipped files, 21485 passed / 19 skipped; typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` (`os validate` / `compile`): 328/328 files, 4816 tests.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, owed by the `(narrowing)` arm) at `c69a7a6d`: 295 passed / 3 skipped files, 2520 passed / 18 skipped.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` gives 114 families; all 114 exit 0 (three first answered exit 3, prerequisite not met, and were re-run once their prerequisite was built or fetched: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`). `--ran` reconciles 114/114. Results are in the os-dev-report comment.

## Acceptance notes

- `${…}` stays a warning where the runner fills it, as the triage ordered. Refusing it is owed once objectui's `ActionRunner` retires the `${…}` reading in `confirmMessage` and `composeSuccessMessage`. Who carries that is a seat call; this PR names it in the report and files nothing.
- Translated copy strings in translation bundles are still not judged, as before this change: the pass reads the action's own slot (and an inline locale map), the same boundary #25205 kept.
- `ActionSchema.errorMessage` and `outcomeMessages` stay outside the family (contract review `6385469184` on PR #25637); a pin asserts a `${…}` in `ActionSchema.errorMessage` still draws nothing.
- Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is the seat's. No governed surface is touched (`.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`).
